sections.heading: 1. Shoulder blade setting
lines: ① Stand tall, arms relaxed by your sides.
② Draw shoulder blades gently back and down.
③ Hold 5 sec × 10 reps, between clients.
④ Keep shoulders away from your ears.

caption:
Momo is on her feet all day with her arms up at the chair, and on busy days her shoulders and neck ache.

Working with arms raised for long spells can tire the shoulders and neck. Adjusting the client chair so your elbows sit a little lower can help share the load. Clinical Pilates can help build the shoulder and upper-back strength that supports long salon days.

Hybi's 1-minute reset: shoulder blade setting, hold 5 seconds, 10 reps, between clients. Stop if your fingers tingle.

Pain that wakes you at night or no change after two weeks is worth an assessment. Come and see us at Hybrid Physio. Book online via the link in bio
